gloss: to fulfill a role; to play one's part

definitions.gloss: to fulfill a role; to play one's part; to serve a function
definitions.explanation: To carry out the duties or function expected of someone or something. Used for people performing their assigned roles and for things serving their intended purpose.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす。
{彼|かれ}はチームで{重要|じゅうよう}な{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たしている。
examples.english: He plays an important role on the team.

examples.japanese: この{橋|はし}は{地域|ちいき}の{交通|こうつう}において{大|おお}きな{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たしてきた。
examples.english: This bridge has played a major role in the region's transportation.

notes:
A very common set phrase combining {役割|やくわり} (role, part) with {果|は}たす (to fulfill, to accomplish). Used broadly for both people and things that serve a particular function or purpose.

USAGE:
Appears frequently in business, academic, and everyday contexts. The subject can be a person (fulfilling their duties), an organization (serving its purpose), or an inanimate object (performing its function).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重要|じゅうよう}な{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす — to play an important role
- {大|おお}きな{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす — to play a major role
- {中心的|ちゅうしんてき}な{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす — to play a central role
- {役割|やくわり}を{十分|じゅうぶん}に{果|は}たす — to fully fulfill one's role

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たす — to fulfill a responsibility; focuses on obligation rather than function
- {務|つと}めを{果|は}たす — to carry out one's duty; more formal and emphasizes obligation
- {機能|きのう}する — to function; used for systems and mechanisms rather than roles
